personality_one_liner: A professional command-center scoring assistant for ICF Carrom matches with precision performance tracking and tactical dark optics.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and compact operational metrics layout for professional sports scoring

do's: Use frosted glass for sticky headers and bottom navigation over scrolling content
Apply translucent tinted base ≥75% opacity in dark mode
dont's: Never blur form fields or dense data tables
Avoid low contrast text over glass

screens.name: Match Setup
screens.purpose: Configure match type (Singles/Doubles), player/team names, referee details, and ICF target points.

states.empty: No recent presets found. Enter player names to begin.
states.error: Failed to load match parameters. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Vertical stacked form with segmented selector for Singles/Doubles, collapsible advanced ICF rule toggles, and sticky bottom primary Start Match button with safe area clearance.

screens.name: Toss & Break
screens.purpose: Perform coin toss and assign initial seating seats and break rotation according to ICF regulations.

states.empty: Toss pending. Select team to toss.

screens.layout: Interactive digital coin toss card with haptic trigger, visual seating arrangement diagram for 4 players (Doubles) or 2 players (Singles), and break indicator assignment.

screens.name: Active Match
screens.purpose: Real-time ICF scorekeeper with visual carrom board, queen cover logic, due/foul tracking, and board history.

states.empty: Board 1 ready. Enter first board score.
states.error: Score sync error. Reverting to last saved checkpoint.

screens.layout: Command-center layout with top scoreboard, interactive visual carrom board with seat indicators and break icon, board history timeline, foul/due counter badge, and bottom quick score resolution pad.

screens.name: ICF Rules & Reference
screens.purpose: Quick reference guide for International Carrom Federation scoring, queen rules, due penalties, and rotation.
screens.layout: Categorized accordion list with search bar, quick rule tags, and official penalty point breakdowns.

carrom_hero.alt: Professional carrom board setup with striker and coins

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-performance Expo React Native app using Dark-First Utility dark theme with amber warm accent (#D97706). Ensure strict support for portrait and landscape adaptive layouts, robust local caching of match histories, interactive board seat rotation, due/foul counters, queen cover validation under ICF rules, and sticky bottom primary CTAs. Follow all accessibility guidelines and touch target sizes ≥ 44pt.
